agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom meeting no. 837 8645 4372
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak, or submit written comments is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Ottawa E-Scooter Program, 2025 Season Results
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Jennifer Armstrong, Director, Transportation Planning, Planning, Development and Building Services and Scott Caldwell, Manager, Parking Services, Public Works provided a presentation and answered questions from the Advisory Committee. A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
The Advisory Committee then heard from the following delegation:
Written correspondence was received from the following members of the public, and is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk:
The Advisory Committee discussed, asked questions and provided feedback regarding the Ottawa E-Scooter Program, 2025 season results.
Following discussions, a motion to defer the matter was introduced.

motions.motion_text: That the matter to receive the presentation and provide feedback as appropriate be deferred to the June 2026 meeting to allow more time for members of the Advisory Committee to consider the matter and information presented, and for staff to provide additional information as requested by members.
That the Accessibility Advisory Committee receive the presentation and provide feedback as appropriate.

agenda_items.minutes: There were no Notices of Motion.
